steps.name: Grani
steps.text: So, this really is the only entrance to the cave, huh?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Mhm. It's like a maze inside the cave, but the village elders have brought me here several times before, including when I succeeded the previous chief...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...Um, I might just be imagining things, but don't you think the shouts from inside the forest are getting louder...?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Things are only going to get worse if we run into any more delays.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Carol, you know your way around inside the cave, right? I'd like you to go inside and retrieve the treasure right now.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Huh? What about you...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'll stay at the entrance.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Huh? Carol...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: You're going to face the bounty hunters alone? That's too dangerous! You'll be...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: If I can't help you secure that treasure, I'd be letting down the entire village, and you as well.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...But, I don't want to lose you.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: This... isn't the time or place for you to be playing hero...!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: What's wrong with playing the hero?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: 'Even with their hearts impaled by the enemy's blades, the King's knights still held on to their spears.'

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I refuse to run away.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Grani...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Besides, Carol, this isn't just my battle.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's also your battle. Perhaps you will run into dangers along the way, but as long as we can restore peace to this land...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: We must face our duties head-on.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I trust that you'll find the treasure.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: But... if I'm alone...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: The treasure...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Trust me.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: No matter what, I'll protect you. Back when I rescued you, I promised that nobody would ever hurt you again.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Not even a single strand of hair on your head.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Even though you're just a kid...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'm no such thing... I'm just vertically challenged!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Haha!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...Mm, I'll do as you said, Grani.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Those damn whitemasks... Why do they always show up at the worst times?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Worthless scum, all of you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You don't even have the right to challenge us for the treasure.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Haaah? What are you talking about? This has long been our turn, so you'd better get lost, or else!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (From this angle, I can see the fighting... It seems that the bounty hunters have gotten into a brawl with Reunion.)

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: (No matter who approaches this cave, I'll make sure I...)

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Let's make a run for the cave while those imbeciles duke it out!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Wait, what's that kid doing there?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You shall not pass.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Gwaah...!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You, it's you—

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Out of my way, all of you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not in the mood to play around.
